alloy.name: Alloy billets
alloy.description: Structural feedstock. Exporting home reserves competes with construction.

water.name: Purified water
water.description: Bulk life-support water. Glacial producers supply thirsty dry worlds.

glass.name: Resonant glass
glass.description: Heat-grown crystal used in sensors. Arid deposits supply colder worlds.

merchant.name: Merchant
merchant.description: Complete distinct commodity deliveries between different worlds. Each origin, destination and commodity combination counts once.

hold.name: Expanded cargo hold
hold.description: Raises commodity capacity from 8 to 16 units. Specimen cradles and energy packs have separate storage.

drive.name: Extended-range drive
drive.description: Raises jump range from 3 to 5 links. Energy consumption stays at 8 per link.
